[7.3.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x15-V7-Error-Logging.md#v73-log-protection-requirements)

> V7.3.4 Verify that time sources are synchronized to the correct time and time zone. Strongly consider logging only in UTC if systems are global to assist with post-incident forensic analysis.

Subcategory V7.3 is "Log Protection" is for protecting logs (confidentiality + integrity), current requirement V7.3.4 is more log content requirement and should belong to subcategory V7.1 "Log Content" and it is part of 7.1.4 (_timeline_):

> V7.1.4 Verify that each log event includes necessary information that would allow for a detailed investigation of the timeline when an event happens.

comments.body:
Correct time synchronization is important in areas of an application security beyond just logging. Things like cluster synchronization or time based access control rules still depend on a proper clock.

--
Jim Manico
@Manicode
